name: comp-13
title: Currency Input Add-on
description: A single-line amount field with a label above it, a euro sign fixed inside the left edge and the letters EUR inside the right edge. Typing an amount pushes the placeholder out of the way.
use: Collecting a price or payment amount where the currency should stay visible as the user types.
avoid: The euro sign and EUR text are fixed, so changing currency or locale means editing the file.
a11y: A real label is bound to the field, but the add-on text sits outside the input so its meaning is not tied to the amount. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a rounded dark text field on a black stage. Inside the field a grey euro sign hugs the left edge, a muted 0.00 placeholder starts after it, and the letters EUR sit at the right edge; focus draws a pale outline.
behaves: Clicking the field shows a focus ring and a caret right after the euro sign, and typing fills the space between the two add-ons. The clip enters 1,250.00 and the field settles with the value held between prefix and suffix.
customise: The euro sign, EUR suffix and placeholder are written in the file; the field styling and disabled opacity are classes you can change there.
weight: light: One styled input and two text spans; nothing runs in the background.
demo: Field labelled Input with inline add-ons, placeholder 0.00, filled with 1,250.00.
polishWhy: Neat aligned add-ons and a clear focus ring, but it is a conventional single field.
